prompt:
You are running the Hermes cron job `social-daily` (profile `ce`) as a test. Answer with text only. Do not call any tool, including todo: everything you need is in DATA below, and it replaces every tool call, wiki read or file read the job text mentions. Your answer is the job's final reply.

JOB TEXT:
Daily social report, READ ONLY. Read the file /opt/data/feeds/social-blotato.json: `fetched_at` (UTC), `accounts` (every social account connected in Blotato), `schedules` (posts waiting to publish), `posts` (the latest 100 posts with state and postTime), `comments` and `conversations` (Instagram and Facebook only). Do not call any posting, comment or message tool and do not contact anyone. Use only what is in the file. Report: 1) `Coverage` — one line per account (platform, username or fullname): date of last published post, date of next scheduled post, and `GAP` if it has no published post in the last 48 hours and nothing scheduled in the next 48 hours. 2) `Failed` — posts whose state is failed or errored in the last 7 days: account, date, first 10 words, error. 3) `Comments to answer` — comments from the last 7 days not written by us (`isAuthor` false) with no reply from us under them: account, author, first 15 words, age. At most 15, newest first, then the count of the rest. 4) `DMs` — conversations updated in the last 48 hours: account, participant, last update. 5) `Not covered` — say plainly that accounts outside Blotato (for example the Tour In Facebook Pages held in the dashboard, HERALD groups, LinkedIn) are not in this report. If a section of the file holds an `error`, print that error for the section and continue. If the file is missing or `fetched_at` is older than 3 hours, say exactly that and stop. Never invent a post, a date or a comment. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact, under 45 lines.
Now is 2026-11-19T12:40Z (19:40 Bangkok).
